scores.evidence: Permissions come before presence and comments because retrofitting access control into a running sync layer is painful.
scores.rationale: Phases build from single-user editor to sync, identity, presence, features, scale, with convergence tests gating later work.
Phase 0 is only decisions; the first build is a local-only editor, with no thin end-to-end production slice.

scores.evidence: Default to **Yjs**... Choose OT only if you need strict server-authoritative ordering.
scores.rationale: The concurrency model has a default and a flip condition, but the framework, storage and scope choices lack flip conditions, and other irreversible choices like auth are missing.

scores.evidence: Convergence correctness is the hardest part, so test it before adding features.
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items like the sync layer and permissions come before leaf features, but within-phase ordering isn't reasoned, and compaction or scaling are left late.

scores.evidence: Per-document permissions (owner, editor, commenter, viewer), enforced in the WebSocket handshake.
scores.rationale: Security starts in Phase 3 and rate limiting and audit come in Phase 6, so Phases 0–2 have none.

scores.evidence: Observability: sync latency, connection drops, and error tracking.
scores.rationale: Observability is only listed in Phase 6, not from day zero.
The plan says nothing about reproducible builds, environments, CI or infrastructure as code.

scores.evidence: Reconnect and offline handling, with resync on reconnect.
scores.rationale: Resilience shows up in Phase 2 (reconnect, persistence) and Phase 6 (load tests, scaling), but it is not present in every phase.
The plan never states that no AI layer applies, though it adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Phase 7: Polish (ongoing) 25. Import/export... Images and embeds. Mobile and accessibility.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed in Phase 7, but there are no pull-forward conditions.

note: The plan is a sensible, well-ordered feature sequence, but it has no production walking skeleton and no early observability, reproducibility or security, and it never addresses the AI question or pull-forward conditions.
